question: Analyze the ChIP-Seq BAM file to identify peak regions using a control BAM. Save significant narrow peaks (q-value < 0.01).

files.eval_guideline: Peak regions must substantially overlap the reference at the base level; exact boundaries may differ.
files.match_reasoning: The files have identical basenames and .narrowPeak formats. The candidate directly corresponds to the requested significant ChIP-seq narrow-peak output.
files.strategy_reasoning: The guideline prioritizes substantial base-level overlap of peak regions while allowing boundary differences. The overlap strategy directly measures total genomic coverage agreement after merging intervals, without requiring one-to-one peak boundary matches.
